generated.method: static inspection of supabase/functions, .github/workflows, infra/ and package manifests

known.spa_host: VPS at 204.168.191.20, deploy webhook on :9000, nginx, SPA built on the box with npm
known.docker: available — infra/stream-proxy is built and pushed as an image by the Deploy workflow
known.edge_runtime: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Hosts the WhatsApp webhook.
known.database: Supabase Postgres with pgvector (ai_embeddings, vector(1536), ivfflat cosine)
known.plan: Hetzner Cloud CCX23 (ubuntu-16gb-hel1-1), Helsinki hel1, eu-central

edge_function_constraints.implication: No local ML model can run inside the WhatsApp webhook. Every 'local' capability below requires a VPS-side service plus an authenticated call from the Edge Function. This is the single largest architectural consequence of the whole audit.

measured.source: Hetzner Console, 2026-08-25; provider independently confirmed from RIPE RDAP (CLOUD-HEL1, Hetzner Online GmbH, FI)
measured.vcpu_type: DEDICATED — the CCX line is dedicated vCPU, not shared, so inference latency carries no noisy-neighbour variance
measured.gpu_note: Hetzner Cloud has no GPU family at all — only Cost-Optimized (ARM), Regular Performance (shared vCPU) and Dedicated vCPU. A GPU is a different Hetzner product (dedicated GEX), so Phase D is a migration, not an upgrade.

capabilities.local_replacement: already done; pdfjs-dist or Apache Tika if a richer layout model is ever needed
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, negligible
capabilities.quality_vs_external: equal — no model involved
capabilities.recommended: keep; this is the existing proof that local-first works here

capabilities.capability: File type, size and MIME validation
capabilities.local_replacement: add magic-byte sniffing (file-type) so a declared MIME is verified, not trusted
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, negligible
capabilities.quality_vs_external: n/a
capabilities.recommended: extend — declared MIME is currently trusted

capabilities.call_site: none found; full-size images are sent straight to the vision model
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~50 MB RSS, <100 ms per image
capabilities.quality_vs_external: n/a
capabilities.recommended: HIGH PRIORITY — strips GPS/EXIF before anything leaves the server, and cuts vision-token cost on every image

capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~20 MB, <50 ms
capabilities.quality_vs_external: better than a general vision model for this task
capabilities.recommended: add — genuinely useful for blind users reading product codes, and it never needs a model

capabilities.capability: OCR — printed text in a photo
capabilities.current_external_dependency: yes — every OCR request is a vision-model call
capabilities.local_replacement: Tesseract 5 (ara+eng+…) via tesseract.js or the native binary; PaddleOCR for harder layouts
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~300 MB RAM, 0.5-3 s per page
capabilities.quality_vs_external: good on clean printed text and receipts; clearly worse on handwriting, skew, low light and mixed RTL/LTR layout
capabilities.recommended: local first, escalate to the vision model on low confidence — Tesseract reports per-word confidence, which makes the escalation rule objective rather than a guess

capabilities.capability: Scene description / captioning for a blind user
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU: 30 s-2 min per image, 4-6 GB RAM — unusable interactively. GPU: 6 GB VRAM, 1-3 s
capabilities.quality_vs_external: materially worse. This is the feature blind users depend on most; a vague or wrong description is worse than a slow accurate one
capabilities.recommended: keep external — the accessibility cost of degrading this outweighs the credit saving

capabilities.current_provider: declines — scannedPdfNotice asks for a photo instead
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~500 MB, 1-4 s per page
capabilities.quality_vs_external: good on clean scans
capabilities.recommended: add — this is a capability gain, not a substitution. Today the user is simply refused

capabilities.capability: DOCX / XLSX / PPTX / CSV text and table extraction
capabilities.current_provider: OpenAI/Gemini for anything not plain text
capabilities.local_replacement: Apache Tika (one service, all formats) or mammoth + SheetJS + a PPTX reader
capabilities.server_requirement: Tika: JVM, ~500 MB-1 GB RAM. Node libraries: ~100 MB
capabilities.quality_vs_external: equal or better for raw text and tables — these are structured formats, not an inference problem
capabilities.recommended: HIGH PRIORITY — extraction is deterministic parsing. Only the summary afterwards needs a model

capabilities.current_provider: local heuristic (Arabic script test) + the model implicitly
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, <10 MB, <1 ms
capabilities.quality_vs_external: far better than the current script heuristic across 20 languages
capabilities.recommended: add — the present heuristic mainly distinguishes Arabic from not-Arabic

capabilities.server_requirement: small int8: ~1 GB RAM, roughly 1-2x realtime on 4 cores. medium: ~2.5 GB, 3-5x realtime — too slow without a GPU
capabilities.quality_vs_external: small is noticeably worse than large-v3-turbo on accented Arabic, dialect and noisy phone audio — which is most of this channel's traffic
capabilities.recommended: local first for short clean clips, external for anything long, noisy or low-confidence. Measure Arabic dialect WER before trusting it

capabilities.current_provider: none — bytes go straight to the provider
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~50 MB, <1 s per minute of audio
capabilities.quality_vs_external: n/a — improves downstream STT accuracy and cuts upload size
capabilities.recommended: add — cheap, and it makes both the local and the external STT better

capabilities.capability: Text to speech for voice replies
capabilities.current_external_dependency: yes — every voice reply, billed per character
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~200 MB RAM, roughly 0.05-0.3x realtime — comfortably faster than playback
capabilities.quality_vs_external: English and several European voices are good. Arabic Piper voices are limited and noticeably more robotic than tts-1
capabilities.recommended: strongest single cost saving, but gate it on a per-language quality judgement. English/European local; Arabic external until a voice is validated by an actual Arabic-speaking blind user

capabilities.capability: Demux, extract audio, key-frames, thumbnails, subtitle muxing
capabilities.current_provider: none — video is refused unless a provider is funded
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only; ~1-5 s for the 6 MB ceiling this channel allows
capabilities.quality_vs_external: n/a — deterministic
capabilities.recommended: add — turns 'I cannot watch video' into 'I transcribed what was said', locally, for the common case

capabilities.server_requirement: inherits image.description — GPU
capabilities.quality_vs_external: much worse
capabilities.recommended: keep external

capabilities.call_site: _shared/aiProvider.ts createEmbedding — used by 8+ functions and the WhatsApp knowledge layer
capabilities.server_requirement: e5-small: ~500 MB RAM, CPU, ~50-200 texts/s. bge-m3: ~2.5 GB, slower on CPU
capabilities.quality_vs_external: multilingual-e5 and bge-m3 are competitive with text-embedding-3-small, and bge-m3 is often better on Arabic
capabilities.blocker: DIMENSION MISMATCH. `ai_embeddings.embedding` is `vector(1536)` with an ivfflat index. No common open model emits 1536. Switching means a new column or table, a new index, and re-embedding the entire corpus — with both indexes live during the cut-over. This is the largest single migration in the whole audit and must not be underestimated.
capabilities.recommended: worth doing for cost and privacy, but plan it as a migration project, not a provider swap

capabilities.current_provider: Mistral → Gemini → Groq → OpenAI (registry order, unchanged)
capabilities.local_replacement: Qwen2.5-7B / Llama-3.1-8B Q4 via llama.cpp or Ollama
capabilities.server_requirement: 8B Q4: ~5-6 GB RAM and 3-8 tokens/s on a typical CPU VPS — a 200-token answer takes 30-60 s. GPU (8-12 GB VRAM): 30-60 tok/s
capabilities.quality_vs_external: materially worse at multilingual instruction-following, and this assistant must be correct in 20 languages
capabilities.recommended: keep external. CPU inference is too slow for a conversational channel where somebody is waiting, and the quality gap is largest exactly where this product is most sensitive

capabilities.local_replacement: fastText or a small fine-tuned classifier; the existing `quickCategory` heuristic already handles the obvious cases
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, ~100 MB, <10 ms
capabilities.quality_vs_external: a trained classifier on a fixed label set is competitive with an 8B model for this task
capabilities.recommended: good candidate — it is a routing label, never shown to the user, already bounded and already optional

capabilities.server_requirement: ~1.2 GB RAM, CPU ~100-300 ms for 15 candidates
capabilities.quality_vs_external: a cross-encoder is a real improvement over a cosine threshold
capabilities.recommended: add — a capability gain with no external dependency at all

capabilities.capability: Geocoding, reverse geocoding, nearby places, weather
capabilities.current_external_dependency: yes, but ALL keyless and free
capabilities.local_replacement: self-hosting Nominatim needs a planet import (64 GB+ RAM, ~1 TB disk); Overpass is comparable. Not proportionate
capabilities.server_requirement: prohibitive to self-host; caching is cheap
capabilities.quality_vs_external: self-hosted is equal but the operational cost is absurd for this volume
capabilities.recommended: keep external, but ADD CACHING. Zero credits are at stake; the real risk is Nominatim's ~1 request/second usage policy, which this code can breach under load with no cache and no queue

capabilities.current_provider: none — everything is synchronous inside the webhook
capabilities.call_site: whatsapp-webhook, bounded only by DEFAULT_ASK_TIMEOUT_MS and the new claim/recovery logic
capabilities.local_replacement: pgmq or a small worker reading a Postgres table
capabilities.server_requirement: CPU only, negligible
capabilities.quality_vs_external: n/a
capabilities.recommended: PREREQUISITE. Local ML is slower and less predictable than an API call. Without a queue, moving work local converts a latency problem into a webhook-timeout problem — and Meta redelivers on timeout

summary.hard_prerequisite: ops.queue plus a VPS-side processing service, because Edge Functions cannot host models
summary.server_verdict: 16 GB RAM and 4 dedicated cores already cover the entire YELLOW tier except chat. The RAM upgrade the audit recommended is unnecessary — it is already there. What is missing is the processing service, not the hardware.
